statBlock.name: Rakdos Lampooner
statBlock.description: A Rakdos satirist who uses pranks and caricatures to ridicule powerful figures.

sections.Spellcasting:
The lampooner casts as a 4th-level Rakdos spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
At will (cantrips). Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery.
1st level (4 slots). Bane, Dissonant Whispers, Silent Image, Tasha’s Hideous Laughter, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Crown of Madness, Enthrall, Suggestion.
sections.Actions: Club. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Rakdos Performer, Blade Juggler
statBlock.description: A Rakdos stage performer who turns juggling knives into a flurry of attacks.

sections.Traits: Performer Type. This profile gives the shared Rakdos Performer statistics with the blade juggler action options.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 249, Rakdos Performer and Blade Juggler actions.

statBlock.name: Rakdos Performer, Fire Eater
statBlock.description: A Rakdos stage performer with a bladed chain and a fiery breath trick.

sections.Traits: Performer Type. This profile gives the shared Rakdos Performer statistics with the fire eater action options.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bladed Chain attacks.
Bladed Chain. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Spew Flame (Recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 249, Rakdos Performer and Fire Eater actions.

statBlock.name: Rakdos Performer, High-Wire Acrobat
statBlock.description: A Rakdos stage performer who uses a barbed pole and springs out of reach.

sections.Traits: Performer Type. This profile gives the shared Rakdos Performer statistics with the high-wire acrobat action options.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Barbed Pole attacks.
Barbed Pole. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. On the hit, the acrobat can jump up to 20 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 249, Rakdos Performer and High-Wire Acrobat actions.

statBlock.name: Reckoner
statBlock.description: A Boros shock trooper who combines sword strikes with lightning magic. Many reckoners are minotaurs.

sections.Traits: First Strike. The reckoner has advantage on initiative rolls.
sections.Spellcasting:
The reckoner casts as a 5th-level Boros spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
At will (cantrips). Blade Ward, Light, Message, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Guiding Bolt, Shield, Thunderwave, Witch Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots). Blur, Levitate.
3rd level (2 slots). Lightning Bolt.
sections.Actions: Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) if used with two hands.
sections.Reactions: Lightning Backlash (Recharge 5–6). When a creature hits the reckoner with an attack, the attacker takes lightning damage equal to half the damage dealt by the attack.

statBlock.name: Rubblebelt Stalker
statBlock.description: A Gruul scout who ambushes enemies in ruins and uses the rubble to escape.

sections.Traits:
Ambusher. In the first round of combat, the stalker has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have yet to take a turn.
Ruin Dweller. The stalker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in ruins. Rubble does not slow it.
Siege Monster. The stalker deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Scorchbringer Guard
statBlock.description: An Izzet guard armed with a flame projector fed by a volatile backpack tank.

sections.Traits: Explosive Tank. The guard’s tank explodes when it dies or rolls a 1 on the Scorchbringer recharge check. Each creature in the 10-ft.-radius sphere makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The blast ignites flammable objects no one wears or carries and destroys the scorchbringer.
sections.Actions:
Light Hammer. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Scorchbringer (Recharge 4–6). The device emits a line of fire 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Each creature in the line makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
